newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow broker rates Rostelekom a buy.
newsitem.headline: Moscow broker rates Rostelekom a buy.

text.p: Moscow brokerage Troika Dialog has rated shares in telecoms company Rostelekom a buy, saying it is well positioned to take advantage of growing domestic demand.
An expected issue of American Depositary Receipts and a $100 million Eurobond in 1997 are likely to increase the already high liquidity of Rostelekeom shares, Troika said in a report.

AOOT Mezhdugorodnoi i Mezhdunarodnoi Elektricheskoi Svyazi Rostelekom controls 93 percent of international and domestic long-distance traffic from and in Russia, and the proposed transfer of controlling interest to Russia's Svyazinvest telcoms holding company was unlikely to hurt its performance, Troika said.

It also recommended Rostelekom for strong earnings and share price appreciation over the last two years -- Rostelekom shares rose by 158 percent in 1996, against a 100 percent rise for the Russian Trading System 24-share index.
Rostelekom's estimated earnings jumped 27 percent in 1996 and are expected to grow a further 22 percent in 1997, it said.
